notes: Data files are pre-cleaned analysis files; all rows used. Study 2 US: OLS on black, group_goal, commitment (police column drops 5 NA rows; respondents count taken from the perceived-violence regression, N=3013). Study 2 Israel: OLS on Ethiopian, Arab, group_goal, commitment, N=3465. Classical OLS SEs (only point estimates and N are scored).
